strike.name: Strike
strike.note: Baseline. Every other action is measured against this.

ember.name: Ember
ember.note: Starter. Hits RES; full power from the back rank.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.note: Ignores 75% DEF but slow. Wins vs armour only. S6.0 exemplar.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.note: 3 hits each rolling crit. Best keen target.

execute.name: Execute
execute.note: v2.8 payoff is CRIT not power. Power flat and HP-independent.

cripple.name: Cripple
cripple.note: Slowed - 33% fewer enemy turns. Best non-heal rule.

brace.name: Brace
brace.note: Fast high charge. Fastest action in the game.

rally.name: Rally
rally.note: Doubles charge rate. Highest charge gain.

gale.name: Gale
gale.note: All foes magic - safe vs thorns.

smother.name: Smother
smother.note: Dulled - cuts enemy MAG and healing.

cinderstrike.name: Cinder Strike
cinderstrike.note: Elemental grid (v2.13): one atk + one mag action per element, so every element gets a physical option for the first time (previously element tags lived on MAG_CAMP only). Split across rarities so no element clusters in one tier - Fire is atk-Common/mag-Rare. Common: power flat, same shape as Strike.

firebrand.name: Firebrand
firebrand.note: Elemental grid. Fire's second mag action alongside Ember/Sear. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Ember's baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.rare).

riptideblow.name: Riptide Blow
riptideblow.note: Elemental grid. Water is atk-Rare/mag-Legendary. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Strike's baseline.

tidalsurge.name: Tidal Surge
tidalsurge.note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Ember's baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.legendary).

quakebolt.name: Quake Bolt
quakebolt.note: Elemental grid. Earth's first mag action - MAG_CAMP had zero Earth coverage before this. Earth is atk-Legendary/mag-Common. Common: power flat, same shape as Ember.

stoneshatter.name: Stoneshatter
stoneshatter.note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Strike's baseline.

squallstrike.name: Squall Strike
squallstrike.note: Elemental grid. Air's first atk action (Gale is mag-only). Air is atk-Common/mag-Rare. Common: power flat, same shape as Strike.

zephyrbolt.name: Zephyr Bolt
zephyrbolt.note: Elemental grid. Air's second mag action alongside Gale. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Ember's baseline.

radiantblow.name: Radiant Blow
radiantblow.note: Elemental grid. Light's first atk action (Dazzle is mag-only). Light is atk-Rare/mag-Legendary. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Strike's baseline.

solarflare.name: Solar Flare
solarflare.note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Ember's baseline.

shadowrend.name: Shadow Rend
shadowrend.note: Elemental grid. Dark's first atk action (Hex/Siphon are mag-only). Dark is atk-Legendary/mag-Common. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Strike's baseline.

umbralbolt.name: Umbral Bolt
umbralbolt.note: Elemental grid. Dark's third mag action alongside Hex/Siphon. Common: power flat, same shape as Ember.

oath.name: Wayfarer's Oath
oath.note: CHARGE - {{name}}. Single burst. Highest power in the game. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

ninefold.name: Ninefold Rain
ninefold.note: CHARGE - Vey. Multi-hit random targeting. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

hearthlight.name: Hearthlight
hearthlight.note: CHARGE - Ansa. Party heal + cleanse. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

vowofstone.name: Vow of Stone
vowofstone.note: CHARGE - Dorrek. Party buff + taunt. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.note: CHARGE - Mirel. AoE damage + DoT. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

bloodfury.name: Bloodfury
bloodfury.note: CHARGE - Skarn (roster expansion). Big single-target hit, heavy crit bonus, partial lifesteal - a reckless crit-fisher that sustains itself. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

spellbrand.name: Spellbrand
spellbrand.note: CHARGE - Sorin (roster expansion). Armor-piercing blade strike that sears the target Frail - melee delivery, magic payload. Rare: power and defPierce scaled up 25%.

wardcurse.name: Warding Curse
wardcurse.note: CHARGE - Nyra (roster expansion). Light AoE damage plus Enfeebled on every foe - shuts down enemy offense from the back line. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

aegisstep.name: Aegis Step
aegisstep.note: CHARGE - Brenn (roster expansion). Self Blurred (+0.20 evade) plus self-taunt - draws every attack, then dodges most of them. The dodge-tank answer to Vow of Stone. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

quicksilver.name: Quicksilver Blessing
quicksilver.note: CHARGE - Sael (roster expansion). Light party heal plus Hasted - trades raw healing for tempo. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

heavystrike.name: Heavy Strike
heavystrike.note: CHARGE - MC generic starter (roadmap item 2). Bulk physical damage to one foe. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Bulk magic damage to all foes. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

greatheal.name: Great Heal
greatheal.note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Heals the whole party. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

wearingdown.name: Wearing Down
wearingdown.note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Physical damage to one foe plus Enfeebled - power scales off the average of ATK and MAG for a build that doesn't lean hard into either camp.

ironresolve.name: Iron Resolve
ironresolve.note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Shields one ally - heal plus Bracing (DEF up) - scales off the average of ATK and MAG same reasoning as Wearing Down.

atk_reckless.name: Reckless Blow
atk_reckless.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop (stat-scaling set). Scales off own ATK, not camp-implied MAG. Heavy single-target hit with a big crit bonus. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

mag_lance.name: Arcane Lance
mag_lance.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own MAG. Piercing magic strike that ignores 20% RES. v2.19: the Piercing Lore bonus used to be dead on it (camp==='atk' only) - now stacks with the built-in defPierce like any physical action. Rare: power and defPierce scaled up 25%.

def_slam.name: Shield Slam
def_slam.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own DEF instead of ATK/MAG. Shield bash that cracks the target's armour (Sundered) - a tank archetype that hits with its tank stat. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

res_strike.name: Warded Strike
res_strike.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own RES instead of MAG. Draining strike that heals 20% of the damage dealt. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

spd_flurry.name: Fleetstrike
spd_flurry.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own SPD. Two quick hits; fires far more often than a normal charge action. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

atk_cry.name: Battle Cry
atk_cry.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A rallying cry - heals the party (scaled by own ATK) and Hastes everyone. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

mag_font.name: Font of Power
mag_font.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A MAG-scaled party heal that also grants Warded. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

def_bulwark.name: Bulwark Stand
def_bulwark.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Shields one ally - heal scaled by own DEF, plus Bracing. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

res_ward.name: Calming Ward
res_ward.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A RES-scaled party heal that also cleanses one debuff per ally. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

spd_fleet.name: Fleet Step
spd_fleet.note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A SPD-scaled party heal plus Hasted - a courier's trick, not a caster's. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

tideturn.name: Tideturn
tideturn.note: CHARGE - RESOURCE/TEMPO. Buys turns deals nothing. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

lastlight.name: Last Light
lastlight.note: CHARGE - REVIVE at 80%. Only full recovery in the game. Rare: no power field to scale (revive-only).

sunder.name: Sundering Vow
sunder.note: CHARGE - DEBUFF-first. Light damage strips DEF from everything. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

gravewind.name: Gravewind
gravewind.note: CHARGE - TEMPO DENIAL. Slows every foe. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

reckoning.name: Reckoning
reckoning.note: CHARGE - CONDITIONAL on target HP. Legendary: power scaled up 55% (the CSV power field is cosmetic here - actual damage is hardcoded in ACTION_DYNAMIC.reckoning in farroad-core.js

bulwarkoath.name: Bulwark Oath
bulwarkoath.note: CHARGE - CHEAP/FREQUENT. Low rank fires often. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

emberglut.name: Ember Glut
emberglut.note: CHARGE - RESOURCE. Doubles own charge rate to chain. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

hollowtoll.name: Hollow Toll
hollowtoll.note: CHARGE - SUSTAIN-AoE. Heals caster 60% of total. Legendary: power scaled up 55%.

sunderingroar.name: Sundering Roar
sunderingroar.note: CHARGE - Stone Ox. Enfeebles the party.

knitbone.name: Knit Bone
knitbone.note: Enemy basic heal -- halved from 1.15 (Fen Priest was unkillable without a damaging charge action).

colossusslam.name: Colossus Slam
colossusslam.note: Super Boss reward (v2.20) - The Stoneheart Colossus, wave 750 tier. Unique: in CHARGE_ACTIONS (farroad-core.js) for pristine-snapshot/Lore-total support, but never in P.MC_CHARGE_DROP_POOL or any other random pool - only obtainable as this bosses first-clear reward. MC-only usable (charge actions have nowhere else to go for a companion) - granted into G.mc.acquiredCharges on first clear.

reapersharvest.name: Reaper's Harvest
reapersharvest.note: Super Boss reward. The Void Reaper, wave 1250 tier. Same uniqueness/MC-only rules as Colossus Slam. AoE dark damage with heavy self-sustain, echoing Hollow Tolls shape at a step above its own Legendary power.

travelersboots.name: Traveler's Boots
travelersboots.note: Legs grant speed and evasion only, per design - no affinity slot here. Common: flat baseline.

windstepgreaves.name: Windstep Greaves
windstepgreaves.note: Rare: spd/evade scaled up ~25% over Traveler's Boots' baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.rare).

skyboundsabatons.name: Skybound Sabatons
skyboundsabatons.note: Legendary: spd/evade scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.legendary).

ironcap.name: Iron Cap
ironcap.note: Head/body grant def+res+one affinity axis. Common: flat baseline, Fire-leaning.

wardedhelm.name: Warded Helm
wardedhelm.note: Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Iron Cap's baseline, Water-leaning.

crownofthebulwark.name: Crown of the Bulwark
crownofthebulwark.note: Legendary: def/res/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Earth-leaning.

chainweavemail.name: Chainweave Mail
chainweavemail.note: Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Padded Vest's baseline, Light-leaning.

aegisofthedeep.name: Aegis of the Deep
aegisofthedeep.note: Legendary: def/res/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Dark-leaning.

worngauntlet.name: Worn Gauntlet
worngauntlet.note: Hand grants atk+mag+one affinity axis - fits either hand slot; own 2 copies to dual-wield the same piece. Common: flat baseline, Body-leaning.

runedbracer.name: Runed Bracer
runedbracer.note: Rare: atk/mag/affinity scaled up ~25% over Worn Gauntlet's baseline, Spirit-leaning.

emberfist.name: Emberfist
emberfist.note: Legendary: atk/mag/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Fire-leaning (wraps the 8-axis cycle back to Fire).

racersstriders.name: Racer's Striders
racersstriders.note: Elemental grid sibling set (v2.15): Swift archetype, speed-leaning over evasion. Common: flat baseline.

windrunnerstriders.name: Windrunner Striders
windrunnerstriders.note: Swift archetype. Rare: spd/evade scaled up ~25% over Racer's Striders' baseline.

tempeststriders.name: Tempest Striders
tempeststriders.note: Swift archetype. Legendary: spd/evade scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline.

nimbleslippers.name: Nimble Slippers
nimbleslippers.note: Evasive archetype, evasion-leaning over speed - same total budget as the Swift archetype, opposite split. Common: flat baseline.

phantomslippers.name: Phantom Slippers
phantomslippers.note: Evasive archetype. Rare: spd/evade scaled up ~25% over Nimble Slippers' baseline.

wornsandals.name: Worn Sandals
wornsandals.note: A 4th Common alternative splitting the difference between the Balanced and Swift archetypes.

sentinelscap.name: Sentinel's Cap
sentinelscap.note: Bulwark archetype, DEF-leaning over RES - same def+res budget as Balanced (Iron Cap), opposite split. Common: flat baseline, Air-leaning.

blessedcoif.name: Blessed Coif
blessedcoif.note: Warded archetype, RES-leaning over DEF. Common: flat baseline, Light-leaning.

shadowedhood.name: Shadowed Hood
shadowedhood.note: A 4th Common alternative splitting the difference between Balanced and Bulwark. Dark-leaning.

vanguardhelm.name: Vanguard Helm
vanguardhelm.note: Bulwark archetype. Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Sentinel's Cap's baseline, Body-leaning.

serenecirclet.name: Serene Circlet
serenecirclet.note: Warded archetype. Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Blessed Coif's baseline, Spirit-leaning.

stormguardcrown.name: Stormguard Crown
stormguardcrown.note: Bulwark archetype. Legendary: def/res/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Air-leaning.

ironcladvest.name: Ironclad Vest
ironcladvest.note: Bulwark archetype, DEF-leaning over RES. Common: flat baseline, Fire-leaning.

tidewovenrobe.name: Tidewoven Robe
tidewovenrobe.note: Warded archetype, RES-leaning over DEF. Common: flat baseline, Water-leaning.

rootplatejerkin.name: Rootplate Jerkin
rootplatejerkin.note: A 4th Common alternative splitting the difference between Balanced and Bulwark. Earth-leaning.

bastionplate.name: Bastion Plate
bastionplate.note: Bulwark archetype. Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Ironclad Vest's baseline, Body-leaning.

hallowedvestments.name: Hallowed Vestments
hallowedvestments.note: Warded archetype. Rare: def/res/affinity scaled up ~25% over Tidewoven Robe's baseline, Spirit-leaning.

emberforgedplate.name: Emberforged Plate
emberforgedplate.note: Bulwark archetype. Legendary: def/res/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Fire-leaning.

riptideknuckles.name: Riptide Knuckles
riptideknuckles.note: Brawler archetype, ATK-leaning over MAG - same atk+mag budget as Balanced (Worn Gauntlet), opposite split. Common: flat baseline, Water-leaning.

stonewovengloves.name: Stonewoven Gloves
stonewovengloves.note: Arcane archetype, MAG-leaning over ATK. Common: flat baseline, Earth-leaning.

zephyrgrips.name: Zephyr Grips
zephyrgrips.note: A 4th Common alternative splitting the difference between Balanced and Brawler. Air-leaning.

radiantknuckles.name: Radiant Knuckles
radiantknuckles.note: Brawler archetype. Rare: atk/mag/affinity scaled up ~25% over Riptide Knuckles' baseline, Light-leaning.

voidwovengloves.name: Voidwoven Gloves
voidwovengloves.note: Arcane archetype. Rare: atk/mag/affinity scaled up ~25% over Stonewoven Gloves' baseline, Dark-leaning.

maelstromfists.name: Maelstrom Fists
maelstromfists.note: Brawler archetype. Legendary: atk/mag/affinity scaled up ~55% over the Common baseline, Water-leaning.

emberwardencrown.name: Ember Warden's Crown
emberwardencrown.note: Super Boss reward (v2.20) - The Ember Warden, wave 250 tier. Unique: never appears in any random drop/pull pool, excluded by id at both equipment pool sites. Scaled ~25% past a normal Legendary head (def/res/affinity) since it is a one-time, hard-won reward rather than a repeatable roll.

sovereigntideblade.name: Sovereign's Tide-Blade
sovereigntideblade.note: Super Boss reward. The Tidal Sovereign, wave 500 tier. Unique, excluded from random pools. Scaled ~25% past a normal Legendary hand item.

tyrantwindstride.name: Tyrant's Windstride Boots
tyrantwindstride.note: Super Boss reward. The Gale Tyrant, wave 1000 tier. Unique, excluded from random pools. No affinity - legs items carry none, by design. Scaled ~25% past a normal Legendary legs item.
